Sandbox_ChangingSkies_EnableAddedWeather: Allows Changing Skies to occasionally ask vanilla to generate an extra weather period. Vanilla weather continues normally.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_AddedWeatherFreque: Chance checked once per eligible ten in-game minutes. Cooldowns and naturally occurring weather add more time between checks.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_AddedWeatherSeveri: Chooses a strength range for vanilla weather generation. This does not set an exact weather type or duration.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_CooldownMinimumHou: Minimum in-game hours before Changing Skies may add weather after any weather period ends.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_CooldownMaximumHou: Maximum in-game hours before Changing Skies may add weather after any weather period ends.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_EnableTemperatureA: Applies seasonal adjustments relative to vanilla while retaining normal daily and weather variation.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SpringColdEndAdjus: Adjusts the cold side of spring's normal temperature range. This is a Fahrenheit difference, not an absolute temperature.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SpringWarmEndAdjus: Adjusts the warm side of spring's normal temperature range. This is a Fahrenheit difference, not an absolute temperature.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SummerColdEndAdjus: Adjusts the cold side of summer's normal temperature range. This is a Fahrenheit difference, not an absolute temperature.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SummerWarmEndAdjus: Adjusts the warm side of summer's normal temperature range. This is a Fahrenheit difference, not an absolute temperature.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_FallColdEndAdjustm: Adjusts the cold side of fall's normal temperature range. This is a Fahrenheit difference, not an absolute temperature.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_FallWarmEndAdjustm: Adjusts the warm side of fall's normal temperature range. This is a Fahrenheit difference, not an absolute temperature.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_WinterColdEndAdjus: Adjusts the cold side of winter's normal temperature range. This is a Fahrenheit difference, not an absolute temperature.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_WinterWarmEndAdjus: Adjusts the warm side of winter's normal temperature range. This is a Fahrenheit difference, not an absolute temperature.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_DebugLogging_toolt: Writes concise scheduler and temperature diagnostics to the game log. Disabled by default.
